skill.summary: YouTubers and content creators add video files into captioned videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud GPUs at 1080...

latestVersion.changelog:
Free Subtitle Generator — initial release

- Launches cloud-based subtitle generation for video uploads up to 500MB.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM inputs; exports 1080p MP4 videos with captions.
- Offers quick setup with automatic token generation and session handling.
- Provides intent-based routing for upload, edit, credits, export, and status commands.
- Includes guidance on processing times, error codes, and supported workflows.
